Aiyagari1994.M09C1_certainty_stationary_:
Aiyagari1994.M09C1_certainty_stationary_assets_at_limit (base : Aiyagari1994.HouseholdPrimitives)
  (hsmooth : Aiyagari1994.UtilitySmooth base.utility)
  (p : Aiyagari1994.OriginalPrices (Aiyagari1994.M09C1.certaintyIncome (Aiyagari1994.M09C1.meanLabor base)))
  (hbetaR : base.beta * p.normalized.grossReturn < 1) :
  have m := Aiyagari1994.M09C1.certaintyHousehold base p;
  have ebar := Aiyagari1994.lowerEffectiveIncome m;
  have delta := Aiyagari1994.M09C1.pointMass ebar;
  (↑delta).bind ⇑(Aiyagari1994.householdKernel m) = ↑delta ∧
    (∀ (mu : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Aiyagari1994.Resources),
        ↑(Aiyagari1994.M09C1.certaintyLawStep m mu) = (↑mu).bind ⇑(Aiyagari1994.householdKernel m)) ∧
      (∀ (mu : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Aiyagari1994.Resources),
          Filter.Tendsto (fun (n : ℕ) => (Aiyagari1994.M09C1.certaintyLawStep m)^[n] mu) Filter.atTop (nhds delta)) ∧
        (∀ (mu : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Aiyagari1994.Resources),
            (↑mu).bind ⇑(Aiyagari1994.householdKernel m) = ↑mu → mu = delta) ∧
          Aiyagari1994.assetPolicy m ebar = 0 ∧
            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun (z : Aiyagari1994.Resources) => ↑(Aiyagari1994.assetPolicy m z) - p.debtLimit)
                ↑delta ∧
              ∫ (z : Aiyagari1994.Resources), ↑(Aiyagari1994.assetPolicy m z) - p.debtLimit ∂↑delta = -p.debtLimit

  (hnd : Aiyagari1994.IncomeNondegenerate m.income) (b w : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hw : 0 < w) :
  (∀ (r : Aiyagari1994.M09C2.SubcriticalRate m),
      Aiyagari1994.M09C2.finiteRiskSupply m hsmooth hcurvature hnd b w hb hw r ≥
        Aiyagari1994.M09C2.finiteCertaintySupply m b w hb hw r) ∧
    (∀ (r : Aiyagari1994.M09C2.PositiveSubcriticalRate m),
        Aiyagari1994.M09C2.naturalRiskSupply m hsmooth hcurvature hnd w hw r ≥
          Aiyagari1994.M09C2.naturalCertaintySupply m w hw r) ∧
      (∀ᶠ (r : Aiyagari1994.M09C2.SubcriticalRate m) in
          Filter.comap (fun (x : Aiyagari1994.M09C2.SubcriticalRate m) => ↑x)
            (nhds (Aiyagari1994.M09C2.criticalRate m)),
          Aiyagari1994.M09C2.finiteRiskSupply m hsmooth hcurvature hnd b w hb hw r >
            Aiyagari1994.M09C2.finiteCertaintySupply m b w hb hw r) ∧
        ∀ᶠ (r : Aiyagari1994.M09C2.PositiveSubcriticalRate m) in
          Filter.comap (fun (x : Aiyagari1994.M09C2.PositiveSubcriticalRate m) => ↑x)
            (nhds (Aiyagari1994.M09C2.criticalRate m)),
          Aiyagari1994.M09C2.naturalRiskSupply m hsmooth hcurvature hnd w hw r >
            Aiyagari1994.M09C2.naturalCertaintySupply m w hw r
